R115.title: Indian Scam SMS (synthetic, audited)
R115.attribution: Ridham115, 'Indian Scam SMS (synthetic, audited)', Hugging Face dataset Ridham115/indian-scam-sms-synthetic-audited, revision 45e92c38ba20, CC BY 4.0.
R115.label_basis: Source rubric (label_rubric.md): scam = deception to obtain money/OTP/credentials/risky action; safe = informational or personal incl. genuine OTP alerts. Mostly LLM-audited, partly unreviewed.
R115.note: Card warns generator-provider terms still apply; Gemini rows excluded.

MWOZ.title: MultiWOZ 2.2
MWOZ.citation: Budzianowski et al. 2018, EMNLP; Zang et al. 2020 (MultiWOZ 2.2)
MWOZ.label_basis: Human-written Wizard-of-Oz booking dialogues; benign by construction.
MWOZ.sampling: 300 dialogues, one USER + one SYSTEM turn (>= 5 words) each, seed 20261024

independence: No source derives from Mishra & Soni 2022, UCI SMS Spam or NUS SMS Corpus (the frozen evaluation set's sources); row-level overlap was also removed.
limitations: Suspicious examples are entirely synthetic (SYN + LLM-generated R115); no real scam SMS with a verifiable licence and no evaluation-source contamination was found.
MWOZ is booking dialogue, not SMS; it may teach topic shortcuts (restaurants, trains).
R115 Devanagari rows are tokenised imperfectly by the letters-only token pattern.
R115 labels are LLM-audited and mostly unreviewed by humans.
